name: Thrumlet · Gremlet #46
description:
A hummingbird that hovers in place to say hello, then zips off mid-sentence.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Thrumlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
